title: Indian Shuttlers Face Tough Japan Quarter-Finals at Asian Games
indian_angle: This story directly impacts the medal prospects of both Indian men's and women's badminton teams at the ongoing Asian Games.
summary: The badminton draws for the Asian Games indicate challenging matches ahead for India's teams, with a likely quarter-final clash against Japan after initial matches against Kazakhstan and Bangladesh.

title: Prannoy Hints at Last Asian Games, LA 2028 Olympics Still Possible
indian_angle: A key Indian shuttler, HS Prannoy, discusses his potential retirement from major events, which is significant for Indian badminton fans.
summary: Former world No. 6 HS Prannoy suggests the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games might be his last, though he keeps the door open for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics if he remains competitive.

title: BAI Level-1 Coaches Course Underway in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This highlights the Badminton Association of India's efforts to develop coaching talent within the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This news details the preparation of India's promising young shuttlers for a major continental junior championship.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change by BAI will impact all young Indian badminton players competing in domestic events.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
